title: The Evil Dolphine
description: This Minecraft plugin adds a command that spawns 10 aggressive dolphins near the player. These dolphins actively hunt and attack nearby players within a 10-block radius.
body:
🐬 The Evil Dolphine Plugin

The Evil Dolphine is a fun chaos-style Minecraft plugin that turns peaceful dolphins into deadly aggressive mobs. Spawn a group of evil dolphins that will hunt and attack nearby players, creating intense and unexpected gameplay moments.

Perfect for trolling, events, chaos SMPs, and fun PvP scenarios.

⚔️ Plugin Features

Spawns 10 aggressive dolphins

Dolphins automatically target nearby players

Deals low but continuous damage (1–2 hearts)

No knockback on hit

Applies Dolphin’s Grace effect to players

Dolphins are persistent and don’t despawn

Lightweight & lag-friendly

📜 Commands
🔹 Spawn Evil Dolphins
/dolphine spawn

✅ Command Details

Spawns 10 evil dolphins near the player

Dolphins attack all players within 10 blocks

Command can only be used by players

🧪 Damage & Effects

Damage: 2–4 (1–2 hearts)

Knockback: Disabled

Potion Effect: Dolphin’s Grace (10 seconds)

⚠️ Warning

This plugin is made for fun and chaos.
Use carefully on survival servers as dolphins can overwhelm players quickly.

📦 Compatibility

Minecraft 1.21+

Works with Paper / Spigot
